designAnswers.twoArms: Legacy arm: CampaignSyncSession.buildBaselineEvent (src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignSyncSession.ts:825, read-only) -> projectCampaignForViewer -> campaignViewerVisibleEvents, whose snapshot decision is src/lib/campaign/sync/campaignViewerProjection.ts:109. Grant arm: projectCampaignStreamForGrant (src/lib/campaign/delivery/projectCampaignStreamForGrant.ts:271) and everything folded from it (buildScopedCampaignSnapshot, the grant channel, the room-code guest join). Both decision points are inside src/lib/campaign, so the predicate needs no edit outside the ownership path: NOT BLOCKED.
designAnswers.predicateLaw: campaignBaselineReachesViewer(baseline, admits, withheldBefore): a viewer admitted to both 'gm' and 'campaign' (entitled to the full state; the same test grantHoldsEveryScope makes, and the legacy GM) receives every baseline; for a restricted viewer a baseline authored 'migration' never passes, and any other baseline passes only while no withheld fact precedes it. A caller that gets false treats the baseline as withheld (latches), so a later full-state checkpoint folded from the imported record cannot pass either. The author distinction is the owner decision's (OD-umbrella-12-1-slice); the ordering half is the legacy arm's existing law (campaignViewerProjection.ts:72-80), which the parity row requires the grant arm to share.
designAnswers.exportLocation: src/lib/campaign/sync/campaignViewerProjection.ts (the shared per-viewer contract module both arms already reach: CampaignSyncSession imports it at :40; the grant arm imports from ../sync already). The literal 'migration' is exported beside it as CAMPAIGN_MIGRATION_AUTHOR_ID and campaignAuthorityMigration.ts:192 stamps that constant, so the producer and the predicate cannot drift apart.
